name: SRD v2.0
descr:
The Daggerheart System Reference Document (SRD) 2.0 is a compilation of the rules of the Daggerheart tabletop roleplaying game, edited and organized for quick reference. It includes the core rules, classes, subclasses, ancestries, communities, domain cards, equipment, loot, adversaries and environments, without the setting information and artwork of the core rulebook. It was created by Darrington Press, released on 2026-08-25 and is available under the Darrington Press Community Gaming License (DPCGL), which allows using the content in your own publications.
